name: QQ Group Follow-up Gate
description: Full-receive QQ group helper: per-turn group hints (incl. restrained sticker/voice tag menu, persona line) + stay_silent tool + standby/NO_REPLY send filter + read-only post-restart warmup + group prompt-cache keepalive (heartbeat into the group session) + probabilistic lurk sticker

silentTool.description: Register the stay_silent tool for QQ group sessions (default true)

silentToolExtraSessionPatterns.description: Extra session-key regexes that also get stay_silent (testing only)

warmup.description: Read-only post-restart warmup of recently active QQ group sessions (default true)

warmupDelayMs.description: Delay after gateway start before the warmup runs (default 25000)

keepalive.description: Group prompt-cache keepalive: invisible heartbeat turn in the group session when the group is quiet

mode.description: live = run heartbeat beats; log-only = only log what would happen (default live)

groups.description: QQ group openids (32 hex) to keep warm

beatAfterMin.description: Beat when the last cache use (real turn or beat) is this many minutes old (default 25)

quietMin.description: Never beat if the group had a real message within this many minutes (default 20)

maxIdleMin.description: Do not beat if the last cache use is older than this (cache presumed cold) (default 29)

maxQuietMin.description: Stop beating after this many quiet minutes; 0 = unlimited (default 0)

startupDelayMs.description: Delay after gateway start before the scheduler starts (default 60000)

requireOwnerLastTurn.description: Only beat when the last real turn was owner-class (heartbeat turns run as the owner) (default true)

hideFromTranscript.description: Keep the beat's poll/NO_REPLY pair out of the OpenClaw transcript (default true)

minCachedRatio.description: Circuit breaker: pause keepalive if a beat's cached-input ratio is below this (default 0.5)

lurkSticker.description: Probabilistic media-only 'lurking' sticker after a keepalive beat

key.description: Sticker key (file name before the first '-') (default 潜水)

minQuietMin.description: Group must have been quiet at least this many minutes (default 25)

nightStart.description: Night window start HH:MM, no stickers inside (default 00:00)

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the night window and the daily cap (default Asia/Singapore)

dailyCap.description: Max lurk stickers per group per local day (default 3)

noConsecutive.description: Never twice in a row: requires real group activity after the previous one (default true)

hideFromMenu.description: Hide this key from the per-turn sticker tag menu (default true)

groups.description: Optional QQ group openids for proactive lurk stickers, intersected with keepalive.groups. Omitted keeps all configured keepalive groups; [] disables stickers in every group.
